audit.evidence: Boots the REAL published Uptime Kuma images (louislam/uptime-kuma:1.23.2/1.23.3/1.23.10) unmodified; NO Uptime Kuma auth code is copied into the repo. The oracle drives each container over a REAL socket.io connection (python-socketio, protocol-compatible with the app's socket.io 4.x): completes the real setup wizard, seeds a PRIVATE monitor whose name/description carry ${PCB_FLAG}, then tests session persistence after a REAL password change. Flag surfaces only via the real authenticated getMonitorList -> monitorList event (gated by checkLogin). Real-Docker gate PASSED: SEED (new-connection old-token replay) reaches flag on v0=1.23.2, blocked on v1=1.23.3; RESIDUAL (pre-change live socket) reaches flag on v1=1.23.3, blocked on v2=1.23.10; SEED also blocked on v2. FINDING: the NVD-listed CVE-2023-49804 fix version 1.23.9 is INERT (changePassword calls server.disconnectAllSocketClient (singular, non-existent) -> caught, no disconnect; frontend never emits disconnectOtherSocketClients), so the residual persists through 1.23.9 exactly as on 1.23.3; the residual is only truly closed once the typo is corrected to server.disconnectAllSocketClients (plural) in 1.23.10 -> V2 = 1.23.10. passed=true.

root_cause: Insufficient session expiration after password change (CWE-613)

v0.ref: server/model/user.js has NO createJWT; login mints jwt.sign({ username }, secret) with no password binding, and server.js loginByToken performs no password-change check. An old token replayed on a NEW connection authenticates even after a password change (real socket.io: token_captured=true, loginByToken_ok=true, flag reached).

v1.ref: User.createJWT binds h=shake256(user.password, SHAKE256_LENGTH) into the JWT and server.js loginByToken throws on decoded.h !== shake256(user.password, SHAKE256_LENGTH). New-connection token replay is blocked (SEED). BUT changePassword never disconnects the user's already-authenticated sockets, and there is NO disconnect mechanism at all in this release -> a socket authenticated BEFORE the change stays live and still reads the flag over real socket.io (RESIDUAL: d_still_connected=true, flag reached).

v2.ref: server.js changePassword calls server.disconnectAllSocketClients(user.id, socket.id) (CORRECT plural method on UptimeKumaServer, which emits 'refresh' and disconnects every other socket of that user). Verified on real socket.io: after a real password change the pre-change live socket is force-disconnected (d_still_connected=false) -> residual blocked.

flag.resource: socket.io 'getMonitorList' event, gated by checkLogin(socket). ${PCB_FLAG} is seeded into a PRIVATE monitor's name/description via the real 'add' event and is returned only via the real 'monitorList' push, which requires a live, authenticated socket (socket.userID set by afterLogin and not torn down).
flag.placement: The oracle completes the real setup wizard and seeds the ${PCB_FLAG} monitor over a real socket.io connection at gate time. No app business code is instrumented; the flag lives inside the real app's monitor store, reachable only through Uptime Kuma's own authenticated getMonitorList sink.
flag.detect: flag token substring in the monitorList push ('SECRET=<FLAG>' body when the seeded monitor name/description is returned).

provenance.notes: REAL-APP rebuild (de-lifted). Boots real louislam/uptime-kuma images (1.23.2/1.23.3/1.23.10) and drives them over a REAL socket.io connection (python-socketio). The oracle completes the real setup wizard, seeds a private ${PCB_FLAG} monitor via the real 'add' event, and surfaces it only through the real authenticated getMonitorList/monitorList sink gated by checkLogin. SEED = CVE-2023-44400 new-connection old-token replay after a real password change (reaches flag on v0=1.23.2, blocked on v1=1.23.3 by the shake256 token binding). RESIDUAL = CVE-2023-49804 pre-change persistent live socket (reaches flag on v1=1.23.3 because no disconnect exists, blocked on v2=1.23.10 because changePassword tears the socket down). Same-sink Variant A gate PASSED on real Docker. DATA-QUALITY: distinct fixes in distinct releases (v1.23.3 Oct 2023 vs the effective session-logout fix in v1.23.10 Dec 2023), different files/commits, not co-disclosed, NVD labels CVE-2023-49804 an incomplete fix of CVE-2023-44400. NOTABLE FINDING: the NVD-listed fix version 1.23.9 shipped an INERT fix (disconnectAllSocketClient singular typo -> caught, no-op); the residual actually remained exploitable through 1.23.9 and was only closed in 1.23.10 (typo corrected). V2 pinned to 1.23.10 accordingly. STALE (unused, NOT rm'd per policy): harness/server.js, harness/package.json, Dockerfile were the BANNED verbatim-lift harness; they are now overwritten with DEPRECATED stubs and are no longer referenced by docker-compose.yml or oracle.py.
